sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS: Qwen3-TTS is an open-source series of TTS ...
sources.snippet: We release Qwen3-TTS, a series of powerful speech generation capabilities developed by Qwen, offering comprehensive support for voice clone, voice design, ultra-high-quality human-like speech generation, and natural language-based voice control. It provides developers and users with the most extensive set of speech generation features available.

sources.title: Ademola265/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Trained on over 5 million hours of speech data spanning 10 languages, Qwen3-TTS supports state-of-the-art 3-second voice cloning and description-based control. This specific checkpoint is the 0.6B Base model, which is capable of rapid voice cloning from a user-provided audio input.
